layers.title: Port Darwin Hydrographic Chart 925 (1942 Corrections)

coverageArea.description: Darwin Harbour, Port Darwin approaches, Charles Point to East Point, inner harbour anchorages

layers.repository: National Archives of Australia (MP1049/5) / Australian Hydrographic Office Historical Collection
layers.technicalNotes: Shows low-water datum, sandbanks, 1942 channels, and original Fort Hill shoreline prior to post-war reclamation. Needs 4-point georeferencing to WGS84 for Cesium drape.

layers.title: RAAF Darwin Post-Raid Aerial Reconnaissance Mosaics

coverageArea.description: Stokes Hill Wharf, Fort Hill, Darwin Naval Anchorage, RAAF Aerodrome

layers.repository: Australian War Memorial (Accessions 011570–011573) / RAAF Historical Branch
layers.technicalNotes: Direct vertical and oblique aerial captures showing smoke columns, sunken hulls, and ruptured oil tanks. Requires orthorectification before texture projection in Cesium.

layers.title: Stokes Hill Town Pier Engineering Damage Survey & Breach Diagram

coverageArea.description: Stokes Hill timber pier head, railway viaduct curve, and MV Neptuna explosion crater

layers.repository: National Archives of Australia (Series A2633 / Series MP1049/5)
layers.technicalNotes: Crucial primary document needed to determine exact timber pier dimensions (length, width, orientation, pile spacing) and breach coordinates. BLOCKING for 3D reconstruction.

layers.title: Darwin Town Cadastral & Building Map (1942 Air Raid Damage Assessment)

coverageArea.description: Darwin Central Commercial District (Smith, Mitchell, Bennett, Cavanagh, Esplanade)

layers.technicalNotes: Documents building footprints, bomb impact craters, destroyed civilian structures (Post Office, Police Station, Government House grounds).

layers.title: Department of Defence Hydrographic & Salvage Survey of Darwin Harbour Wrecks

coverageArea.description: Darwin Harbour seabed wrecks: USS Peary, Meigs, Mauna Loa, British Motorist, Zealandia, Neptuna debris field

layers.repository: Australian Hydrographic Office / Northern Territory Museum and Art Gallery (MAGNT)
layers.technicalNotes: Modern multibeam sonar surveys and historical salvage coordinates provide high-precision seabed positions for major wrecks.
